audit.whatIsWrong: The chart reads Skill / Urgot x5 / Skill on both layers while every one of its own why-strings says Kled, Kled, Kled, Urgot, Urgot, Kled, Kled — which is the packet levelChart exactly.
audit.why: Kled owns levels 1-3 through Skaarl's second health bar and the Bear Trap pull; Urgot's only window is 4-5 after Skaarl is shredded off; Kled retakes it at 6 with Chaaaaaaaarge!!! and remount sustain and keeps it with items. The side tokens were never updated to the prose, so the page shows an Urgot-favoured lane it then argues against.
audit.corrected: All seven rows proposed as matched full+content pairs to the packet chart, ratings realigned, and six phase whys rewritten so each row states its real reason.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 and two-item rows carried generic Urgot-spike text ('Black Cleaver stacks instantly', 'Sterak's + Cleaver makes your W-trades unloseable') on rows that belong to Kled.
audit.why: Kled's real spikes are Chaaaaaaaarge!!! at 6 — 140s at rank 1, dropping to 110s — which also shields him, and the Violent Tendencies steroid plus remount healing with items. Urgot's spike is the level 4-5 dismount window, before the ultimate lands.
audit.corrected: phases[3], phases[5] and phases[6] whys rewritten around the dismount window, the 140s shielded charge, and the 110s late-game engage.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions were absent everywhere: Chaaaaaaaarge!!! grants Kled a shield on the charge, and Violent Tendencies is an auto-attack-speed burst whose wind-up — not its cast — is the step-back cue. breakdown.cooldowns also carried no numbers at all.
audit.why: Firing your burst into the arrival of a shielded charge wastes it; the shield has to be forced out first. And because W is four fast attacks rather than a cast, a player watching for an ability animation reacts a full burst too late. Bear Trap is 11s at rank 1 with 800 range and yanks you in after a shackle delay — that is the punishable cooldown.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns given the 11s/800 and 140s figures; dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d and the three dontsFull bodies rewritten to state the pull delay, the remount, and the shield-before-burst rule.

edits.before: Q start for safe poke. Each auto fires an Echoing Flames leg — chunk Kled on every last-hit, but don't burn all six legs into one trade.
edits.after: Skaarl is a second health bar and Bear Trap yanks you in from 800 — take Q, chip the wave, and refuse the level-1 all-in entirely.

edits.before: E or W second depending on kill pressure. A landed E-flip into W spray already wins most level-2 exchanges outright.
edits.after: Bear Trap into Violent Tendencies is a real level-2 kill threat — W is four fast attacks, so step out on the wind-up.

edits.before: Full legs rotation online — this is your lane now. Walk Kled down with W whenever Bear Trap on a Rope is on cooldown.
edits.after: His W shred and Skaarl's free health bar still beat your trades. Chip Skaarl on last-hits, but do not commit a pattern yet.

edits.before: Q and W ranks make the grind trades brutal. Force Kled to choose between CS and health; he can't have both into your spray.
edits.after: This is your window: shred Skaarl off him. Dismounted, he loses the free bar and his Q becomes a weak ranged pistol shot.

edits.before: Black Cleaver stacks instantly with W — your shred turns even tanky answers soft. Shove and force Kled to trade into the spike.
edits.after: Chaaaaaaaarge!!! lands at 6 on a 140s cooldown and shields him on arrival, and remount sustain hands his health bar back.

edits.before: Sterak's + Cleaver makes your W-trades unloseable head-on. Kled must dodge E forever or find a jungler — punish the first mistake with R.
edits.after: His W steroid, remount healing and a 110s R engage win the extended duel. Use R only to punish a low Skaarl, and group instead.

edits.before: - Kled Bear Trap on a Rope: matchup-defining — His engage hook. Dodge it. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Kled Bear Trap: 11s at rank 1, 800 range, and it yanks you in. - Chaaaaaaaarge!!!: 140s, shields him.

edits.before: His engage hook. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His 800-range hook, 11s at rank 1. Commit only once it is down.

edits.before: Kled wastes Bear Trap on a Rope — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Shred Skaarl off him; dismounted he loses the free bar and the pull.

edits.before: That is Kled's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Shackled for a moment, the trap yanks you into his four-attack W burst.

edits.before: Burning your answer for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Remount hands Skaarl's health bar back — finish the trade, don't pause.

edits.before: Standing still and face-tanking while W sprays — without rotating fresh legs or landing E, Kled simply walks through the spray and out-damages you.
edits.after: His R shields him as he charges in, so burst fired into that arrival is wasted — force Chaaaaaaaarge!!! out first, then run your pattern.
